messages:
carmen: Heads-up — critical tokenization regression in eu1 causing ~0.5% failed generations on long prompts. Patch ready (v3-hotfix-eu1). Need expedited approval for a short-change-window deploy tonight 22:30-23:00 UTC. Can we skip canary and do a rapid rollout with strict rollback criteria? @raj @sylvia @marta

deploy-bot: Release candidate created: v3-hotfix-eu1 (sha256:abcd1234...). Auto-checks: unit/smoke passed. Canary skip requires 2 human approvals + oncall ack per policy.

raj: oncall here. I can sign off if rollback plan + automated hooks are in place. Also need a clear pin strategy so we can force previous model if anything regresses.

sylvia: infra: what's the perf delta? did staging show any latency regressions?

carmen: staging perf looks OK — median latency +8ms, p95 within threshold. Root cause is tokenizer edge-case; quantization tweak applied. Plan: rollout with tight health gates; if errors >0.2% or p95 >120ms we rollback immediately to v2.9.8. Hot rollback script and model pin are ready.

marta: product: we need release note blurb for compliance, I'll draft if approved. Approve pending raj + infra.

deploy-bot: Rollout plan (configured):
```
step1: route 5% for 10m
step2: route 25% for 10m
step3: route 100% for 15m
health checks: error_rate > 0.2% OR latency_p95 > 120ms -> TRIGGER_ROLLBACK
rollback target: model v2.9.8, disable-quantization-flag=true
commands:
/deploy start --release v3-hotfix-eu1 --region eu1 --rollout "5:10m,25:10m,100:15m" --health "errors>0.2% or p95>120ms" --rollback "v2.9.8"
```

carmen: Given the automation and hot rollback, I'm ok with skipping an extended canary. Asking for explicit +1 from @raj.

raj: +1 (oncall). I will be monitoring metrics and can hit rollback. :white_check_mark:

sylvia: +1 from infra. I'll watch the infra dashboards and have the emergency pin command ready. :eyes:

marta: +1 from product. Drafting release notes now, will post to #announcements after deploy. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled for 22:32 UTC (change window 22:30-23:00). Notifying oncall and incident channels. If rollback executes, this thread will update automatically.

carmen: Thanks — I'll run post-deploy smoke (quick prompt set) and report within first 5 minutes. Ping me immediately if you see anything unusual.

oncall-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu1-hotfix-deploy — rollback checklist included.

raj: noted. Ready on my side.

sylvia: standing by.

marta: will post release note after success. Good luck team.
